query: Let `R` be a ring, `v : R → ℝ` a non-archimedean absolute value, and `c > 0` a real number. Then for any `p, q ∈ R[X]`, `gaussNorm v c (p · q) = gaussNorm v c p · gaussNorm v c q`.
